en.name: Gladiator
en.ability: Once per game, during the day, publicly choose a living player. Tonight, you and they wake & silently play roshambo: whoever loses dies (someone must lose).

revisions.v1: Once per game, during the day, publicly choose a living player. Tonight, you and they wake & silently play roshambo: whoever loses dies (someone must lose).

en.flavor: "Forgive me. I was trained with swords! Not with words." - Crixus 72 B.C.
en.otherNightReminder: If the Gladiator used their ability today wake the Gladiator and the player they chose: both players silently play roshambo (rock "fist", scissors "two fingers" or paper "flat hand"). If they both chose the same, play again. Play until someone wins. The loser dies.

zh.name: 角斗士
zh.ability: 每局游戏限一次，在白天时，你可以公开选择一名存活玩家。当晚，你和他会被唤醒并秘密猜拳：输的人死亡（必须分出胜负）。

revisions.v1: 每局游戏限一次，在白天时，你可以公开选择一名存活玩家。当晚，你和他会被唤醒并秘密猜拳：输的人死亡（必须分出胜负）。

zh.flavor: ‘原谅我。我是被刀剑训练出来的！不是语言。’-克雷斯 前72年
zh.otherNightReminder: 如果角斗士在今天白天向一名玩家发起决斗，唤醒角斗士和他挑战的那名玩家。他们进行猜拳直到分出胜负，输者死亡。
